brief:
Israel First leader Sharren Haskel has called for a government coalition that excludes Palestinian-led parties, Middle East Eye reported. Haskel blamed far-right leaders for increasing Palestinian voter turnout, according to the outlet.

The demand follows recent electoral developments in which Palestinian participation in Israeli politics drew attention from senior Israeli figures. Haskel's statement reflects ongoing tensions over the role of Palestinian representatives in Israel's political system.
dek: ‘Without the Arabs!’: Israeli politicians urges government excluding Palestinians Israel First leader Sharren Haskel has demanded a coalition excluding Palestinian-led parties after blaming far-right leaders for boosting Palestinian voter turnout.
title: Israeli politician demands coalition excluding Palestinian-led parties
